subject: SOC 2 refresh: evidence handoff timeline + renewal throughput/top-up
messages:
From: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@novusbank.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: SOC Team <soc2@novusbank.com>, Procurement <procurement@novusbank.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: SOC 2 renewal + retention window question

Connor — thanks for the renewal notice. Quick context: our audit window is in Q1 and the auditors will expect a fresh evidence bundle by Jan 15. Two items we need clarified before we lock dates: 1) Redwood has proposed the default 90-day log retention; our regulator is likely to ask for 180 in certain jurisdictions — can you confirm if you can extend retention to 180 for our EU tenant? 2) We will probably increase concurrent session volume by ~25% in H1; can we get a throughput/top-up pricing estimate tied to the renewal?

Can you confirm a timeline for the evidence handoff and whether the expanded retention requires a contract amendment? 

Thanks,
Alice Jenkins
Lead Information Security Analyst
Novus Bank
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@novusbank.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 renewal + retention window question

Alice — appreciate the heads up. High level answers up front: we can support a 180-day retention for the EU tenant and we can provide a short-term throughput top-up for the H1 uplift. Details: 

- Retention: Extending from 90 -> 180 days is supported via our Private retention profile. For Hosted accounts we can enable an EU-retention policy tied to the Novus EU tenant. It will require a one-line contract amendment for data retention terms and a minor pricing delta (roughly +6% on the storage/ingestion component).

- Throughput/top-up: We can provision a Dedicated burst pool for the first half of the year. Ballpark cost: $X/month for a 25% burst on your current committed capacity; I asked our pricing team for an exact quote and will include Monica here who can run the numbers.

Timeline for evidence: we typically deliver an evidence index and a secured transfer location within 7 business days after kickoff, then staggered artefact handoffs over 2–3 weeks. To meet Jan 15 we should start the evidence sprint by Dec 15 at the latest. Attached is an initial evidence index template to collect artifacts (novus-soc2-evidence-index.xlsx).

Next steps I propose:
1) Contract amendment draft for the retention change (we can prepare).
2) Pricing quote for the temporary burst capacity (Monica will respond).
3) Kickoff meeting — can we schedule Dec 3 or Dec 7 for a 30-minute run-through?

Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@novusbank.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 renewal + retention window question

Hi Alice — thanks, Connor. I pulled the throughput history for Novus and ran a quick projection. To cover the expected 25% concurrent uplift for H1 with a safety margin we recommend a 30% temporary burst for the Jan–Jun period. Pricing estimate (pre-negotiation):

- Temporary Dedicated burst (30%): $14,500/month (includes reserved GPU cycles + autoscale buffer).
- One-time staging/transfer assistance for evidence handoff: $2,100 (secure SFTP + checklist mapping + one-hour onboarding with our compliance ops).
- Retention amendment: +6% of current monthly storage/ingest usage (we can provide dollar delta when you share current storage metrics).

Operational notes:
- We'll enable an EU retention policy scoped to your EU tenant; log export formats remain the same (gzipped JSON) and we will provide the supply of signed manifests for auditors.
- For the evidence sprint: we prefer artifacts uploaded to the shared Drive folder (we can also accept SFTP). We will deliver a completeness manifest and a transcript of who touched which artifact for chain-of-custody.

I can prepare a formal quote and a one-line amendment draft; Connor if Dec 3 kickoff is good I can attach the quote during the meeting. Alice — which time zone is better for you? Morning ET or mid-afternoon PT?

Regards,
Monica Patel
Director, Customer Success — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
From: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@novusbank.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: SOC Team <soc2@novusbank.com>, Procurement <procurement@novusbank.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T16:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 renewal + retention window question

Thanks — that all sounds reasonable. Dec 3 at 11:00 AM ET works for Novus. A few clarifications before kickoff: 

- Please include the retention one-line amendment draft in the calendar invite so our legal team can triage before the meeting.
- For the quote, please show the delta to our current committed spend (line items for burst, staging, and retention delta). Procurement will need a clear monthly and annualized number.
- We'd prefer the evidence transfer via SFTP; please provide the host/key details during the kickoff so we can schedule our team to start uploads the week after the meeting.

Also, small ask: can you include a short note about fallback policy if burst capacity is exhausted (we want to confirm automatic graceful degradation to smaller model variants rather than outright throttling)? That will be part of our technical sign-off.

I'll send a calendar hold for Dec 3 11:00 AM ET. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Alice Jenkins
Lead Information Security Analyst
Novus Bank

--
Attachments referenced: novus-soc2-evidence-index.xlsx
